input_variables.description: JSON object of input variables to pass into the sub-flow's start node / variables. This is the sub-flow's input payload — set whatever keys the target flow expects.

graph_id.description: ID of the saved flow (graph) to run as a sub-flow. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent — the agent never chooses which flow to call.

api_key.description: EpicStaff API key used to authenticate the run-session / session-status calls (sent as the X-Api-Key header). Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent.

api_base_url.description: Base URL of the EpicStaff Django REST API, e.g. http://djangoapp:8000/api. Optional — if unset, falls back to the DJANGO_API_URL environment variable, then to http://djangoapp:8000/api.

poll_timeout_s.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the sub-flow to finish before giving up. Optional, default 300.
